question: Convert 8.5% into a decimal.
solution:
The correct answer is __0.085__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Percentages are converted to decimals by dividing the percentage value by 100.
 
• To convert 8.5% into a decimal, divide 8.5 by 100.
 
• The result is 0.085.
 
• This method works for all percentage values.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Decimal Representation:**
 
 
• Decimal numbers are numerical values expressed in the base-10 system.
 
• They are often used to represent fractions or percentages in a simplified form.
 
 
 
• **Percentage Basics:**
 
 
• A percentage is a fraction or ratio expressed as part of 100.
 
• For example, 50% means 50 out of 100 or 0.5 in decimal.
